description:
This private guided tour will provide you with the opportunity to get an up-close look at some of the artworks by renowned artists at the Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel and St Peter’s Basilica. 

Along with your guide, you will explore the galleries of the Vatican Museums. You will get to see Roman statues, painted maps, as well as the works of Bernini, Raphael, Botticelli, Perugino and others. Then, you will visit the Sistine Chapel to view Michelangelo’s frescoes that decorate the interior. You will also be taken to a terrace that offers a panoramic view overlooking the Vatican Gardens. 

Afterwards, you will head to St Peter’s Basilica where you will find Michelangelo’s sculpture, Pietà, and the tombs of Peter the Apostle and John Paul II.

additionalInfo:
Comfortable clothing is recommended.

Please note that the sites are subject to last minute, unpredictable closures due to strikes, union meetings or other events.

This tour is wheelchair accessible. Please inform the tour provider during checkout in case you require wheelchair access.

Audio headsets will be provided only for groups with a minimum number of eight people.

Large bags, suitcases and liquids of any kind are not permitted inside the premises. There is no deposit room to store such objects.

Please bring your ticket with you to the attraction.

Be aware that operators may cancel for unforeseen reasons.

You need to be 18 years or older to book or be accompanied by an adult.
